shots.name: poster
shots.prompt: Static camera, no zoom, no cuts. A stylized 3D animated photographer stands in profile on a snowy rise at first light, camera raised to her eye toward the glowing sun; soft snowflakes drift slowly, the warm lanterns along the tree-farm paths below twinkle and the pale gold light on her scarf brightens. Expressive stylized 3D animated performance, smooth character animation. Same faces, same clothes, nothing morphs or drifts. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fade.

shots.name: diorama
shots.prompt: Locked-off tripod camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts. A tiny isometric diorama of a snowy tree farm sits on a pale lavender studio backdrop in cool pre-dawn light. The diorama is a still miniature model: the barn, the pines, the lantern posts and the slab are fixed in place like a photograph and never move, rock or sway. Only the light is alive: the barn window flickers on with a soft warm glow. Clean pale backdrop throughout. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fade.

shots.name: m_lit
shots.prompt: Continuous single take, locked-off tripod camera, no camera movement. On the tiny still snowy tree-farm diorama on a pale lavender backdrop, the little lanterns along the path come on one by one, glowing warm gold on the snow, the barn window lights up and a few big soft snowflakes start to float down. The barn, the pines and the slab are fixed in place and completely motionless; only the light and the snowflakes change. No cuts, no fades, no morphing, no dissolve. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fade.

shots.name: farm_family
shots.prompt: Static locked-off camera on a tripod, no zoom, no push-in, no dolly, no camera movement at all, no cuts. At the tree farm the photographer kneels in the snow on the left and shoots, steady; the family of four stay exactly in place, smiling and laughing gently: the little boy on the stump holds up his snowball and giggles, the girl sways a little and waves one hand slowly, the parents lean in with their arms around each other, everyone looks at the camera; soft snowflakes drift down. Calm, small, smooth, slow movements only, no jumping, no bouncing, no fast arm movements, no waving both hands. Everyone keeps both feet on the ground or on the stump, nobody lifts anyone. Expressive stylized 3D animated performance, smooth character animation. Same faces, same clothes, nothing morphs or drifts. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, saturated colours, bright clean snow, no haze, no fade.

The tree, the carousel and the buildings stand perfectly still. Everyone keeps both feet on the ground. Expressive stylized 3D animated performance, smooth character animation. Same faces, same clothes, nothing morphs or drifts. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fade.
